description: We are supplying proprietary timber load-bearing wall members for a four-storey office whose structural design is under Part 4. We propose to use only our internal resistance factors and a European wood design method instead of demonstrating conformity with the Canadian engineering-design-in-wood standard. Our catalogue capacities are the intended basis.
known_facts: internal factors and European method in place of Canadian wood design conformity

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: Part 4 wood structural design replaces conformity with CSA O86 with a different design basis.
gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
